answer: The strongest sybil defense is slow trust: influence equals account age times verified honest epochs, tracked in a shared atlas ledger. A fresh identity is just a whisper, unable to vote or move markets regardless of capital. Peer attestations and audits increment the honest-epoch counter, so trust compounds slowly. An attacker cloning thousands of raven personas gains nothing for months; each fake account must run honestly and pass audits to matter, so attacks cost sustained good behavior rather than money, capping new-account speed.
